'''Mārcis Auziņš''' (born 11 January 1956) is a [[Latvia]]n [[physicist]]. From 2007 to 2015 he served as the [[Rector (academia)|rector]] of the [[University of Latvia]]. In 1998, Auziņš was also elected a member of the [[Latvian Academy of Sciences]]. In 2005 he was a [[Miller Institute|visiting Miller professor]] at [[University of California, Berkeley]]<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://millerinstitute.berkeley.edu/all.php?nav=47&to=1 |title=All Visiting Miller Professors, Sorted by Name - Miller Institute |access-date=2013-02-11 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140730022129/http://millerinstitute.berkeley.edu/all.php?nav=47&to=1 |archive-date=2014-07-30 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== Education ==
* [[University of Latvia]] (Faculty of Mathematics and Physics) 1979
* Dr.phys (cand. Phys. Math. Sciences), [[Saint Petersburg State University]], 1986
* Dr. habil. phys., [[University of Latvia]], 1995
